title: China Enterprise Globalization Weekly: Ant International Secures ~USD 1.2B Series A Financing | Zhixiang Future Closes RMB 1.5B Series C Funding - 36 Kr
summary: China Enterprise Globalization Weekly: Ant International Secures ~USD 1.2B Series A Financing | Zhixiang Future Closes RMB 1.5B Series C Funding  36 Kr
reason: 新闻标题和摘要提到Ant International（蚂蚁集团旗下）获得约12亿美元A轮融资，直接涉及中国科技公司的国际化动态和海外业务融资，符合主题1和6。
